svg.aria-label: Ticker-tape press for Anthropic's first trading day (ANT, Nov 19, 2026). The tape enters from the supply spool at the $111.50 open, 34 percent above the $83 IPO price; the lit-orange die stamps the day's range — high near $115.10, low $92.72 — and the tape winds onto the take-up spool at the $97.17 close, up 17.07 percent on 813 million-plus shares traded. The price dial reads the close inside the day's range, and the lever throws the press. Verified numbers: open $111.50, high about $115.10, low $92.72, close $97.17, IPO price $83.00, 813M+ shares, about $1.75 trillion fully diluted value at close, after-hours $92.60, down 4.7 percent.
